1) Confirm the procurement contact (name + email) who will manage vendor setup?
2) Tell us whether a PO (Net 30) or card payment is preferred for the pilot?
3) If PO, can you send your vendor onboarding form (or confirm we can upload to your vendor portal)?

I’ll loop in Marissa (commercial ops) and Monica (finance ops) to help with the vendor setup once you confirm.

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — the demo was helpful. A few items from procurement: 

- Preferred path: PO (Net 30) for vendor relationships at our org size. We can do a card for a very small POC but governance prefers a PO.
- Vendor packet: I’ve attached our vendor onboarding checklist (fields our portal requires). Can Redwood complete that form? We use Coupa for vendor onboarding but can also accept DocuSign.

- Banking: Once vendor setup is approved, we’ll need remit-to banking details or an ACH authorization form.

Also: can you confirm whether billing via AWS Marketplace is an available option for this account? It would simplify ordering but procurement will need exact contract and license terms.

Looping in Jason Lee from procurement (procurement lead) to coordinate.

Hi Elena / Jason —

Great — thanks for the checklist. Quick answers and proposed action items: 

1) PO vs Card: We are happy to proceed with a PO (Net 30). For the pilot, if you want to accelerate, we can accept a card, but we will initiate vendor setup immediately for PO billing.

2) W-9: Attached is our signed W-9 (sample_W9.pdf). If you need a corporate signature page or notarized copy, let us know and I’ll loop legal.

3) Vendor form: I attached our standard vendor packet (redwood_vendor_packet_v2.pdf) — that covers the fields on most vendor checklists (legal name, EIN, remit, banking). If your Coupa form requires data in a specific layout, please send it and Monica will populate it and return either via DocuSign or upload.

4) Banking / ACH: We can provide an ACH authorization and remit-to instructions once vendor enrollment is approved. We typically provide bank name, account type, ACH routing, and an operations contact.

5) AWS Marketplace: Redwood’s public listing is available, but some enterprise engagements do better via direct invoicing due to contract terms and SOWs. We can explore Marketplace procurement if your procurement team prefers it — I’ll ask Marissa to confirm whether the current SKU/licensing will match your needs.

Action items: 
- Jason: please confirm the preferred delivery format for your vendor form (Coupa upload or DocuSign) and share the Coupa vendor template if needed.
- Jason/Elena: confirm billing address and PO contact.
- Monica/Marissa: I’ve asked them to standby to fill your form and provide ACH details when enrollment is accepted.

I’ll attach the vendor packet and W-9 again below for easy reference. Happy to set a short call between procurement ops and our finance ops to walk through the fields (15–20 minutes).

Thanks,
Karthik
